metadata.name: Gridiron
metadata.description:
[h1]Gridiron: American football for Isaac[/h1] Suit up! Football gear with its own mechanics: no reskins, no stat-only items.
[h2]What's inside[/h2] [list] [*][b]20 items[/b]: Football Helmet (tackles, stuns and a facemask), Shoulder Pads, Team Jersey, Football Cleats, Eye Black, Receiver Gloves, Mouthguard, Padded Pants, QB Wristband, Foam Finger, Super Bowl Ring, Gatorade Bucket, plus the Kicking Tee, Pigskin, Playbook, Coach's Whistle and End Zone actives [*][b]3 familiars[/b]: Cheerleader, Water Boy, Tackling Dummy [*][b]3 trinkets, a card and a pill[/b]: Referee Flag, Concussion Protocol, Turf Burn, Coin Toss, Timeout! [*][b]Wear 3+ pieces to get Suited Up[/b]: bonus damage, faster tackles, gold glow [*][b]Worn costumes[/b]: modern helmet with facemask, jersey over pads, pants and cleats, eye black [*][b]Pick your team colours[/b]: helmet, jersey and pants, 10 colours each, from the settings menu [*][b]A new boss[/b]: The Linebacker, plus Mascot and Referee enemies [*][b]A new character[/b]: The Quarterback and Tainted Quarterback [*][b]3 challenges[/b]: Fourth and Long, Two-Minute Drill, Ground Game [*][b]Settings[/b] in the Dead Sea Scrolls menu (press C), External Item Descriptions support, save & continue support [/list]
[h2]Synergies with base-game items[/h2] [list] [*]Mars dashes are tackles; Aries and Taurus make tackles go live faster; Leo, Thunder Thighs and friends hit harder [*]Magneto and Telekinesis help the Receiver Gloves; Infamy helps the Shoulder Pads [*]Brimstone, Technology, Mom's Knife and other non-tear weapons still throw footballs [*]Footballs take on your tear effects: fire, poison, holy light, ice, charm, Midas... [*]Explosive items make bigger field goals; magnets make better fumbles [*]Holy Water, lemons, Ball of Tar and Juicy Sack turn the Gatorade shower into creep [*]Pony speeds up first downs; Money = Power doubles the Super Bowl Ring; Marked boosts the Foam Finger [*]Tarot Cloth lands the Coin Toss on its edge; BFFS! upgrades the sideline crew [/list] EID lists every synergy on the item it belongs to.
Debug console: [b]gridiron give[/b] drops all the gear as pedestals, [b]gridiron boss[/b] summons the Linebacker.
Requires Repentance+. REPENTOGON is not required. Source and bug reports: github.com/bulmaspanties/tboifbm
